_how_to: Owner override for event cancellations and postponements. This is the fast path when an organizer announces on social media and no feed carries the change (the Alive @ Five heat cancellation, 2026-07-02).
Add a notice below, commit to main, and the deploy (~3 min) does the rest: a red banner on the event page, the event drops off What's on, and a Heads up item leads /today.
slug: the event's URL path after /events/ (open the event in the app and copy it from the address bar).
status: cancelled | postponed | advisory. advisory shows the headline and note WITHOUT calling the event off (moved indoors, delayed start, expect crowds).
headline: the one-line news for /today, e.g. 'Alive @ Five is cancelled tonight'. note: one sentence of detail, shown under the headline and on the event page.
source_url: where the organizer announced it. expires: the last Eastern day (YYYY-MM-DD) the notice shows; the day after, it retires itself. For a one-night cancellation, use the event's own date.
From a phone: github.com > this file > pencil icon > edit > commit to main. Nothing else to do.

notices.headline: Alive @ Five is cancelled tonight
